title: Password Reset
text: Employees can use the self-service password reset portal anytime. After 5 failed attempts, IT manually unlocks the account. No approval is required.

title: VPN
text: VPN access is automatic for full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and the employee renews them.

title: Laptop Replacement
text: Employees are eligible for laptop replacement after 3 years, or earlier for verified hardware failure. Requests should be made at least 2 weeks before the intended replacement.

title: Software
text: Software in the catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.

title: Printer
text: For printer issues, check the queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists, create a ticket with the asset tag.

title: Mailbox
text: The default mailbox size is 25GB. Employees should archive old mail. Increases above 25GB require manager approval and cannot exceed 50GB.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
text: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee at the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required.

title: Expense Software
text: Finance grants access to the expense software, not IT. IT handles login or technical issues once the account exists.

title: Security
text: Suspected phishing, malware, or unauthorized access should be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example. It should not be forwarded to other employees.

title: WFH Equipment
text: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time chair/monitor allowance. Manager sign-off and Finance processing are required. IT ships only after approval.

title: Asset Management Policy
text: Company hardware follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from the date of issue. Early replacement outside the cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
